svg.title: How often adaptive rules call for the full outer measurement

cc:Work.dc:title: How often adaptive rules call for the full outer measurement
cc:Work.dc:description: Log-log plot: the share of rounds in which rules B and C call for the full outer measurement falls roughly in proportion to p, from 82% and 97% at p = 5e-3 to 0.9% and 3.6% at p = 1e-4; about 10% and 30% at Helios today.
